# 24: Constraints a relational schema does not carry (§6.4)

**The model says.** One model holding each constraint type that has no relational counterpart: anchored, ring, frequency, subset, equality, exclusion, exclusive-or, mandatory-disjunctive, value, value-comparison, both cardinalities, subtype-partition, textual and guarded.

**A Halpin reader expects.** The tables come out normally: Person's columns and unary flags, plus two own tables. Every one of those constraints is listed as `not-relational`, with its type, and none is dropped.
